rules_proposed.rule: Fixture models must be finished and detailed, and must match the room's specified material palette; plain boxes or exposed services are not acceptable unless explicitly specified.

Doors in the same architectural set must have consistent leaf height, width, and style; mismatched door leaves are not acceptable.
Paired furniture must use the same model and finish; a bed-side nightstand pair must be a matched set.
Paired furniture must use the same model and finish; mismatched nightstands are not acceptable.
Furniture models must be scaled and detailed appropriately for the room and adjacent pieces; flimsy or out-of-scale models are not acceptable.
Window models must include appropriate joinery or trim and must match the architectural style; plain untrimmed uPVC is not acceptable in a styled project.
Stair models must use finished materials consistent with the surrounding floor and wall finishes; raw concrete or exposed voids are not acceptable unless specified.
Furniture models must be finished, not low-detail placeholders; crude slat or box models are not acceptable in a furnished render.
Door frames must use a finish that is part of the room's specified material palette; unexplained third materials are not acceptable.
Exterior glazing frames must be proportionate and stylistically consistent with the facade; heavy industrial frames are not acceptable on a light residential facade.
